katas.title: Event types: rename the duplicate-slug error code to say "Conflict"

provenance.find: **B. A booking conflict maps to 400, not the advertised 409.**

defects.scenario: A host creates a second event type with a slug they already use; the API answers through ResultExtensions.ToActionResult.
defects.consequence: The status is chosen by substring on the code (ResultExtensions.cs:28 wants ".Conflict", "Taken" or "AlreadyCancelled"). "EventType.SlugConflict" contains none of them ("." is followed by "Slug"), so the duplicate-slug response silently changes from 409 to 400 and clients that branch on 409 break.

defects.scenario: The 409 mapping is decided here, not by the Error.Conflict factory the handler calls.
defects.consequence: Error.Conflict(...) does not record a type, so "it is a Conflict error" is invisible to the mapper; only the string matters.

defects.scenario: Same trap already shipped for bookings: "Booking.TimeConflict" falls through to 400.
defects.consequence: Review finding B: the patch spreads a known 400-instead-of-409 defect to a second endpoint (and breaks the existing CreateEventTypeHandlerTests assertion on the code).
